title: What to do if you discover bed bugs in a hotel room
desc: Inspect rooms safely and prevent bringing infestations back to your house.
todos: Place luggage in the bathroom tub immediately upon entering before inspecting the room.
Pull back mattress sheets to inspect seams, headboard cracks, and box springs for small dark spots.
Notify hotel management immediately with photo evidence and request a room at least two floors away.
Keep luggage elevated off carpeted floors on metal luggage racks throughout your stay.
Wash all clothes in hot water and dry on high heat for 30 minutes immediately upon returning home.
